entries.reason: RPG systems publish access contracts; none mutate ECS structure and each names its owning component and thread.
entries.entity_scope: RPGActor ECS entities registered by RPGActor::createActor / liveActors()
entries.view: no View traversal that mutates while iterated; systems read actor components and run on liveActors()
entries.read_set: Attributes, Statuses, Skills, Progression, Vitals, Traits and ClassInfo components as applicable
entries.write_set: the system's owning component (Vitals/Progression/Traits/ClassInfo/Skills) and event queues only
entries.structural_changes: no structural ECS mutation from within update; actor destruction is explicit and deferred by callers
entries.events: status tick/change, cast, vitals, level-up and battle events polled after update
entries.services: injected dt/turn time and named seed streams; no global mutable time or wall clock
entries.phase: script/game-driven simulation; Battle is turn-based, others are update(dt)-driven

entries.reason: Known actor checkpoint fields are serialized through a typed Protobuf record instead of Value-mediated JSON.
entries.migration: Existing version-1 JSON is accepted through Protobuf JSON mapping; new saves can use binary bytes.
entries.unknown_fields: Version 1 ignores unknown binary and JSON fields, preserving prior actor checkpoint behavior.
entries.restore_atomicity: Class, traits, attributes, progression, vitals and skills validate in a private candidate before commit.

entries.reason: Known RPG game-state facts are serialized through a typed Protobuf message instead of a Value object.
entries.migration: Existing nested-map version-1 JSON is parsed through Protobuf Struct as a read-only compatibility migration; new saves use Protobuf binary or its JSON mapping.
entries.unknown_fields: Version 1 ignores unknown binary and JSON fields, as the prior game-state loader did.
entries.restore_atomicity: All numeric values and duplicate scopes validate in private maps before four no-fail swaps publish the new state.

entries.reason: Party checkpoints compose typed actor Protobuf messages directly, with no Value/JSON intermediate.
entries.migration: Existing version-1 JSON is read through Protobuf JSON mapping; new snapshots can use wire bytes.
entries.unknown_fields: Version 1 ignores unknown binary and JSON fields, as prior Party restore did.
entries.restore_atomicity: The complete roster and every actor candidate validate before any actor commit.

entries.reason: Quest progress uses a versioned Protobuf record while the JSON entry points remain a compatibility projection.
entries.migration: Version-1 JSON is read through Protobuf JSON mapping; unsupported versions fail before mutation.
entries.unknown_fields: Version 1 ignores unknown binary and JSON fields to preserve the prior quest tracker policy.
entries.restore_atomicity: All quest identities, objective bounds and state invariants are checked in a private Tracker candidate before swapping live state.

entries.reason: RPG preparation validates the complete bound domain state before joining the cross-domain commit.

provides.absent_behavior: RPG state is excluded from saves without this explicit participant

trim.absent_profile: games without RPG omit this adapter and do not link the RPG package

cost_notes: Full RPG snapshot parsing and candidate preparation per load.
